_notes: MEGA HUNT PASS: every Hunt Pass season from Frostfall (2018) to Time Strike (2021) plus the winter 2020-21 event passes, in release order, 400 levels.

Elite row (the one the screen shows) = the season cosmetics; each season ends on its Ultra/finale level. Free row = 100 Rams per level, cores (Common every 5, Uncommon every 10, Rare every 50), a Transmog Stone every 10 levels, and a special dye at levels 10, 30, 50 ... 390 and 400 (the dyes the dye screen shows; the 18 behemoth dyes are left to behemoth progression).
claim_mode grant = the metagame puts each level's free AND elite rewards straight into your inventory when you reach it (like mastery rewards); items appear after rejoining a server.
Restart the metagame after editing (no rebuild needed). Rewards: [catalog_id, quantity]. 'chapter' is just a label.

xp_curve (optional): list of XP per level, overrides xp_per_level. Pass XP comes from the game itself (end of hunt, part breaks, gathering) plus claimed bounties. weapon_xp_ratio: optional extra pass XP per Weapon Skill XP (0 = off).
prestige: after the last level, every xp_per_level XP is one more prestige level paying these rewards.
